patterns.note: Editorial-style full-bleed photography is frequently used, often paired with text in an asymmetrical layout, creating a magazine-like visual flow between product grids and brand storytelling sections.

A sophisticated serif font is used for prominent display text and chapter headings, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body copy, navigation, and product details, establishing a clear typographic hierarchy.

The site predominantly uses a muted, earthy color palette of warm off-whites, beiges, and soft greys for backgrounds, with dark brown and charcoal text, conveying a sense of natural elegance and understated luxury.

The hero section features a layered scroll effect where the background image and foreground text elements (like the brand name and chapter title) scroll at different rates or temporarily stick to the viewport, creating a dynamic sense of depth and reveal.
Content is structured into distinct 'Chapter' themed sections, reinforcing a narrative approach to presenting collections and brand values, moving beyond typical product categories.

technique_notes: A sticky header element is positioned fixed to the top of the viewport, ensuring continuous access to navigation and brand identity as the user scrolls down the page.

The hero section utilizes CSS keyframe animations to create a layered scroll effect where the background image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground text elements, which also temporarily stick to the viewport, creating depth and a dynamic reveal.

A modal overlay is revealed using CSS keyframe animations, sliding in from the left side and remaining fixed after the user scrolls past a certain point on the page, typically used for newsletter sign-ups or promotions.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (hero text is very large, ~4-5x body) are paired with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase navigation labels, creating a sophisticated contrast.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied across all elements, including images, buttons, and content blocks, contributing to a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous spacing is used throughout, particularly in editorial sections and around product grids, creating a sense of luxury, focus, and unhurried browsing.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-quality, editorial photography and a 'chapter' narrative structure for content sections elevates it beyond a typical e-commerce site, creating a strong brand story and a luxurious, magazine-like browsing experience. The subtle layered scroll effect in the hero section further enhances this premium feel.
